preregistration.purpose: Exploratory post-baseline model-family development on an already inspected within-source cohort; not confirmatory or independent validation.
preregistration.features: The common temporally complete rows and [MI_t, MI_t-1, MI_t-2, MI_t-3, MI_t-4] generated only from consecutive one-minute observations within an animal, exactly as in the frozen prior nested evaluation. No labels, future values, identifiers, breed, or ranch are predictors.

folds.outer: Use the six frozen animal-level outer assignments in experiments/diagnostics/behavior/preregister-perea-nested-animal-evaluation-2026-10.json; each animal is test exactly once.
folds.inner: Within each outer training set, sort animals within breed and assign one per breed to each of five fixed folds, matching the previous preregistration.
folds.fitBoundary: Scaling and sample weights are computed using only the current training partition. No animal may cross a train/validation/test boundary.

selection.primaryMetric: Equal-animal mean of per-animal F1 for RE and RU, with equal class weight.
tieBreakers: fixed simplicity order: static logistic, temporal logistic (lower C first), CART (shallower first), RandomForest, HistGradientBoosting

candidates.model: existing fixed full-batch multinomial logistic regression on MI_t, as in prior nested candidate set
multinomial L2 logistic regression C=0.1; train-only StandardScaler
multinomial L2 logistic regression C=1; train-only StandardScaler
multinomial L2 logistic regression C=10; train-only StandardScaler; prior selected comparator
DecisionTreeClassifier max_depth=4, min_samples_leaf=20, random_state=20261013; prior selected comparator
RandomForestClassifier n_estimators=100, max_depth=6, min_samples_leaf=20, max_features=1.0, n_jobs=1, random_state=20261013
HistGradientBoostingClassifier max_iter=100, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=20, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=20261013

selection.trainingWeights: Equalize animal contribution, then equalize total class mass across the four labels, using training rows only.
selection.selectionProcedure: For each outer training set, make stitched inner animal-group OOF predictions for every fixed candidate, select only by the stated inner metrics and tie-breakers, refit the selected candidate on all outer training animals, and predict the held-out animals. Also report all fixed candidate outer OOF results descriptively.
selection.advancementRule: No candidate is considered improved unless the expanded nested procedure exceeds the prior nested-selection primary score on the same frozen outer folds and the lower 2.5th percentile of its animal-cluster paired bootstrap difference exceeds zero. This is exploratory development and cannot establish generalization beyond these animals.

uncertainty.method: Paired percentile bootstrap of animal-level metric contributions, resampling the 24 animals as intact groups with replacement; 10000 replicates, seed 20261013.
uncertainty.interpretation: A descriptive within-cohort sensitivity interval only; not predictive calibration, not an interval over ranches or populations. No row-level bootstrap.

required: outer-fold train CPU and per-animal held-out inference CPU timing
diagnostics.ranch: The source's two ranches are confounded with breed; ranch labels are not present in the analysis CSV. Report that ranch-specific contrasts are not identifiable and make no ranch transport claim.

reproducibility.no_search: No parameter search outside the nine fixed candidates above.

pairedBootstrapExpandedMinusPrior.resampledUnit: animal (24 groups, intact; paired candidate values)

evaluation.interpretation: Exploratory within-cohort improvement signal only; not independent validation.

ranch.reason: The input CSV has no ranch identifier and the two ranches are confounded with breed; no ranch contrast or transport claim is made.
